city_name: Belém & Baía do Guajará (Amazon gateway), Brazil

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário de Belém (Luiz Rebelo Neto)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Belém (Reduto / Av. Marechal Hermes, port waterfront)
boarding_points.operator: CPH — Companhia de Portos e Hidrovias do Estado do Pará
boarding_points.notes: The state intermunicipal terminal, rebuilt for COP30: R$53M, 4,800 m². Departures to Marajó (Soure/Salvaterra via fast lancha), Cametá, Ponta de Pedras and the Marajó archipelago; weekend Geladão Fluvial departures to Mosqueiro. OSM 'Terminal Hidroviário Rebelo Neto' (dock).

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário Ruy Barata (Praça Princesa Isabel)
boarding_points.operator: Cooperative lancha operators / Prefeitura de Belém
boarding_points.notes: The Ilha do Combu gateway: hourly cooperative lanchas, R$12/leg, 15-min crossing; also the first Mosqueiro geladão departures. OSM 'Terminal Fluvial Turístico de Belém' pier at Praça Princesa Isabel matches press descriptions of the Ruy Barata terminal.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário da Tamandaré
boarding_points.linked_locale: Belém (Cidade Velha waterfront / Nova Tamandaré linear park)
boarding_points.operator: Government of Pará (federal-state partnership); Arapari Navegação services
boarding_points.notes: Opened 3 Nov 2025 as COP30 legacy; replaced the old Ver-o-Peso wooden port for Barcarena and island departures. Not yet mapped in OSM. Candidate coordinate: unnamed OSM pier at lng -48.5074396, lat -1.4596372 (Vila Porto do Sal, Cidade Velha) — confirm before rendering; coordinate left null rather than guessed.

boarding_points.name: Estação das Docas (Pier Amazon River)
boarding_points.notes: Belém's showcase waterfront: restored warehouses, restaurants, and the Pier Amazon River where daily river cruises depart (R$90/person orla sunset cruise). Natural premium boarding point next to Porto Futuro II. Coordinate is the OSM complex node; berth sits on its river face.

boarding_points.name: Ver-o-Peso waterfront quay
boarding_points.notes: The iconic market waterfront where Barcarena boats historically berthed (service moved to the new Tamandaré terminal in Nov 2025). Retained as a heritage/tourism boarding node. Coordinate is the OSM market node on the waterfront.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário Turístico de Icoaraci
boarding_points.operator: CPH — Companhia de Portos e Hidrovias do Estado do Pará
boarding_points.notes: Opened 8 Oct 2025 (R$7.9M, COP30 legacy); ~2,000 boardings/day expected. Geladão Fluvial water-bus to Cotijuba (R$4.60 weekday); Marajó-facing tourist services; hosted COP30 hospital-boats. OSM ferry_terminal, address matches official release.

boarding_points.name: Icoaraci ferry ramp (Balsa Icoaraci–Camará)
boarding_points.operator: Henvil / regulated ferry concession (ARTRAN-PA tariff table)
boarding_points.notes: Vehicle-and-passenger ferry to Camará (Salvaterra, Marajó): regulated max tariff R$24.80 passenger / R$145.87 vehicle. Adjacent to the new tourist terminal. OSM named pier 'Balsa Icoaraci-Camará'.

boarding_points.name: Trapiche de Cotijuba
boarding_points.notes: Arrival pier of the Geladão Fluvial from Icoaraci (20 min, R$4.60 weekday / R$9.20 weekend) and the new 2026 direct Belém line. Car-free beach island; motor vehicles banned. OSM named pier 'Trapiche Cotijuba' at the village.

boarding_points.name: Trapiche do Outeiro
boarding_points.notes: Pier of the Outeiro beach district (bridge-linked island); near the new Outeiro port terminal that hosted COP30 cruise-ship hotels (~55.5k passengers estimated by the terminal administration). Spur node for the northern bay. OSM named pier.
boarding_points.source: https://www.instagram.com/p/DL2zC-evt6I/ | OSM Overpass (named pier 'Trapiche do Outeiro')

boarding_points.name: Ilha do Combu north-shore restaurant landings (Saldosa Maloca cluster)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Ilha do Combu (APA — state environmental protection area)
boarding_points.notes: Dozens of over-water restaurant piers line Combu's north shore facing Belém (OSM shows 40+ named restaurants along ~2 km). Coordinate anchors the cluster at Saldosa Maloca, the island's best-known restaurant; passengers state their restaurant at boarding.
boarding_points.source: https://ilhadocombu.tur.br/ | OSM Overpass (restaurant cluster, Ilha do Combu)

boarding_points.name: Trapiche Poeta Antônio Tavernard (Mosqueiro)
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Belém (weekend Geladão Fluvial line)
boarding_points.notes: Named arrival/return pier of the Belém–Mosqueiro Geladão Fluvial (220-pax lancha, weekends, R$20). Not confidently resolvable in OSM: an unnamed OSM pier exists at lng -48.4745986, lat -1.1654441 (Av. Beira Mar, Maracajá, Mosqueiro) but attribution to the Tavernard trapiche is unverified — coordinate left null rather than guessed.

boarding_points.name: Porto do Camará (Salvaterra, Marajó)
boarding_points.notes: Marajó's vehicle-ferry gateway from Icoaraci; onward road/van links to Salvaterra and Soure. OSM named pier 'Balsa Camará-Icoaraci'.

boarding_points.name: Soure waterfront (Trapiche Municipal / Porto da Rabeta)
boarding_points.operator: Master Motors / Banav fast lanchas; municipal trapiche
boarding_points.notes: Arrival point of the ~2h Belém fast lanchas (R$61.17) and the Soure↔Salvaterra local crossing. OSM shows 'Trapiche Municipal' and adjacent 'Porto da Rabeta' ferry terminal; coordinate is the Trapiche Municipal.

boarding_points.name: Barcarena — Porto São Francisco (sede)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Barcarena centro (gateway to the Vila do Conde industrial complex)
boarding_points.notes: Terminus of one of Pará's busiest lines: hourly ~62-pax lanchas to Belém, 45–60 min tide-dependent, R$17.58–18. Serves Barcarena town and the Vila do Conde alumina/aluminium complex hinterland. OSM ferry_terminal at Travessia São Francisco, Centro.
